programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: When Adam asks the most awarded chef in Australian history, Peter Gilmore, and acclaimed author Elizabeth Hewson to cook food in their element, it's a night to remember.

programs.title: Cheese Slices
programs.desc: Comté dates back 700 years and is the most important cheese made under the French appellation system. Will travels to the alps to visit a typical dairy, before visiting the old fort of Saint Antoine where thousands of crusty wheels of cheese are matured underground. Then it's off to a small farm to discover how Morbier acquired its black charcoal stripe.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
programs.desc: Adam hits the streets to show us Osaka's incredibly delicious array of cheap eats. He spends the day with a retired sumo wrestler, then indulges in some delicious baseball stadium food.

programs.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programs.desc: In Wales, Adam tries Glamorgan sausage in Glamorgan. He enjoys Welsh rarebit and wonderful Welsh cakes, and bites into his Polish heritage with pierogis.

programs.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty
programs.desc: When Buddy gets a request from Anthony Shriver to create a cake for the Best Buddies Challenge, he's thrilled; the team runs into some difficulties when this cake has to travel on a bumpy sea plane.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
programs.desc: The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.
